sprung_inertia_tensor_kg_m2.source: active_vehicle_config.json (Ixx=45, Iyy=85, Izz=120), mirena_ws-SIM_02-11 (Izz=135), ter26.py (Izz=150). Sprung tensor has parallel-axis unsprung contribution subtracted so total assembled 14-DOF M(q) matches total vehicle inertia.

wheel_tire_spin_Iy.source: 10-inch Braid/Keizer rim + Hoosier 16.0x7.5-10 R20 rotational inertia (without gearbox)

rocker_pivot_Iz.source: 7075-T6 CNC aluminum bellcrank inertia about pivot

motor_rotor_inertia_kg_m2.source: active_vehicle_config.json wheel_inertia = 0.32 kg*m^2 (0.24 wheel + 0.08 reflected rotor/drivetrain)
